reviewMethod: Independent visual inspection of all 20 original paper pages and scheme PDF pages 43–76, including every model solution, alternative method, diagram, scale, construction tolerance and detailed credit note. All 37 question and 37 solution crops visually inspected.
sourceNotes: All 20 original paper pages and scheme PDF pages 43–76 independently visually inspected, including cover pages, blank working pages, model solutions, alternatives, diagrams, scale table, detailed notes and web amendments. All page references are PDF positions.
37 separately practicable tasks and 37 scale components. Q5(a)(i) and (ii) have separate published marks. Q2(c), Q4(d), Q6B and Q7(b) remain holistic tasks.

Full Credit Minus One applies only to the seven starred tasks: Q5(a)(i,ii), Q7(a)(iii), Q7(b), Q8(b,e,f). Q7(b) follows the detailed 5C* despite the unstarred summary; Q2(d) follows its published 0,3,4,5 ladder despite the omitted C.
Q6A(a) retains the original construction triangle, paper reader ruler and ±3 mm midpoint tolerance. Q7 keeps original table, CSO attribution, all slides and both graphs.
Q7(a)(iii) accepts 2.6–3.0 with work, exceptionally 2.8 without work; Q7(c) accepts a correct answer without work. Candidate-answer follow-through retained in Q2(b), Q5(b) and Q8(f).

Q8(b) printed 70√3 is corrected in a separate source note to 35√3 = 70 sin 60°; original scheme image unchanged. Q7(e)(i) source note qualifies the claim that graphically negligible bars prove zero households.
